tool.name: Degap.seqs
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$fasta' fasta.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.dat")
echo 'degap.seqs(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log
tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The degap.seqs_ command reads a fasta file and outputs a fasta containing the sequences after all gap characters are removed.
.. _degap.seqs: https://mothur.org/wiki/degap.seqs/
